近年来，激进政治经济学家对信用与金融问题的兴趣重新兴起，这既反映了国际金融体系的显著增长，也反映了它的不稳定。这一兴趣的复兴尤为重要，因为在过去三十年盎格鲁-撒克逊激进政治经济学的复兴中，信用与金融并未占据突出地位。

In recent years, there has been a revival of interest in the issues of credit and finance among radical political economists, reflecting both the remarkable growth and the instability of the international financial system. The revival of interest is especially important because credit and finance have not featured strongly in the renaissance of Anglo-Saxon radical political economy during the last three decades.
从激进政治经济学立场出发对信用与金融的分析具有若干鲜明特征，包括强调货币体系所承载的社会关系，以及高度关注非均衡。尽管如此，近期马克思主义及其他激进派对信用与金融的许多分析，其理论根基与主流理论的区别仍不够充分。这一点在借贷概念（包括贷款的需求与供给）所依据的方法论个人主义上表现得尤为明显。

The analysis of credit and finance from the standpoint of radical political economy has some distinguishing features, including emphasis on the social relations encapsulated by the monetary system and a strong focus on disequilibrium. Nonetheless, the theoretical underpinnings of much of the recent Marxist and other radical analyses of credit and finance have not been sufficiently differentiated from those of mainstream theory. This is particularly notable with regard to the methodological individualism that underlies the concepts of borrowing and lending, including the demand and supply of loans.
本文认为，对信用与金融的激进分析的恰当根基可以在马克思本人的著作中找到，尤其是在他的生息资本（或借贷资本）概念中，即作为商品交易并要求支付利息的货币资本。与之相关的是马克思的一个特征性观点：利息率与利润率并不趋于均等化，这一原则会引出强有力的理论结论。

This paper argues that appropriate underpinnings for a radical analysis of credit and finance can be found in Marx’s own work, and above all in his concept of interest-bearing (or loanable) capital, i.e. money capital traded as a commodity and commanding the payment of interest. Related to it is Marx’s characteristic view that the rate of interest and the rate of profit do not tend to equalisation, a principle that leads to strong theoretical conclusions.

然而，马克思对生息资本的分析也存在相当大的歧义。本章认为，在马克思的著作中可以识别出对这一概念的两种分析路径。第一种从拥有货币的资本家（“货币资本家”）与拥有投资项目的资本家（“职能资本家”）之间的关系推导生息资本的特征。第二种则聚焦于社会总资本周转中闲置货币额的产生，这些闲置货币随后被信用体系转化为借贷资本。两种分析路径彼此不相容，并导向对信用与金融截然不同的理论分析。本章进一步认为，后者远优于前者。

Nevertheless, there is also considerable ambiguity in Marx’s analysis of interest-bearing capital. It is argued in this chapter that two approaches to the concept can be identified in Marx’s work. The first derives the characteristic features of interest-bearing capital from the relationship between a capitalist who possesses money (the ‘monied’ capitalist) and a capitalist who possesses an investment project (the ‘functioning’ capitalist). The second focuses on the generation of idle sums of money in the turnover of the total social capital, which are transformed subsequently into loanable capital by the credit system. The two approaches are not mutually compatible and lead to very different theoretical analyses of credit and finance. It is further argued that the latter is much superior to the former.

children: 利息作为一种收入形式，其来源与性质在经济理论中争论已久，至今仍相对模糊。古典政治经济学识别出三大收入来源，并把它们分别同资本主义社会的三大阶级联系起来：利润归资本家，工资归工人，地租归土地所有者。对古典经济学家而言，利息作为收入来源并不与这三者等量齐观，即利息不被认为界定了一个分量相当的独立社会阶级，也不被认为对社会的经济分析具有同等重要性。

The source and nature of interest as a form of revenue have been extensively disputed in economic theory and still remain relatively obscure. Classical political economy identified three major sources of revenue, linking each of them to the three great classes of capitalist society: profit to capitalists, wages to workers, and ground rent to landlords. For classical economists, interest as a source of revenue was not considered to be on a par with these three, i.e. interest was not considered to define a separate social class of similar weight, nor was it seen to be of equivalent significance for the economic analysis of society.
不过，古典经济学家也识别出一个与利息获取相联系的独特社会群体，常被称为“货币资本家”。
这一群体实际上构成资本家阶级的一部分，其特征按亚当·斯密的说法是其成员“不愿费心亲自运用”自己的资本。于是他们把资本贷给别人以收取利息。
对古典经济学家而言，以利息形式获取的收入把“货币资本家”同产业资本家和商业资本家区别开来。同理，古典经济学家倾向于把利息范畴视为资本所产生并赚得的利润的一部分。利润率通常被设定为利息率的“调节者”，尽管这种“调节”的确切性质在主要古典经济学家的著作中仍含糊不清。
However, classical economists also identified a distinct social group associated with the accrual of interest, frequently called the ‘monied’ capitalists.

This group actually comprises a section of the capitalist class, and its characteristic feature is that its members, according to Adam Smith, ‘could not be at the trouble of employing’ their capital by themselves. Thus, they lend it to others at interest.

For classical economists, revenue accruing in the form of interest differentiates ‘monied’ capitalists from industrial and commercial capitalists. In the same vein, the classical economists tended to treat the category of interest as a share of the profits generated and earned by capital. The rate of profit was typically posited as the ‘regulator’ of the rate of interest, though the precise nature of such ‘regulation’ remained ambiguous in the work of the leading classical economists.
在《资本论》的某些部分，马克思对利息概念采取了一种与古典学派非常相似的分析路径。
在这些章节中，马克思部分地依赖这样一个假设来分析生息资本的性质：贷出资本的资本家（单纯拥有货币）向借入资本的资本家（单纯拥有投资项目）发放贷款。于是利息表现为借入资本家的投资项目所产生利润的一部分。

Capital

In these chapters, Marx analysed the nature of interest-bearing capital by relying partly on the assumption that lending capitalists (who simply own money) advance loans to borrowing capitalists (who simply possess investment projects). Thus, interest emerges as a fraction of the profits generated by the investment projects of the borrowing capitalists.

children: 价值在循环中采取三种形式：货币、商品和生产要素（工人与生产资料）。循环中的货币只存在于流通领域，在这一狭义上，货币保留了一切市场过程所共有的前资本主义面貌。尽管如此，循环也把货币与生产有机地联系起来；剩余价值的榨取为价值在货币形式上的持续扩张提供了机制。因此在资本主义条件下，商业交易中的普通货币变成了货币资本，成为产业资本基本运动的起点。

Value takes three forms in the circuit: money, commodities, and factors of production (workers and means of production). Money in the circuit is found exclusively in the sphere of circulation, and in this narrow sense money retains a pre-capitalist aspect common to all market processes. Nevertheless, the circuit also organically links money to production; the extraction of surplus value provides a mechanism for the continuous expansion of value in the money form. Under capitalist conditions, therefore, the plain money of commercial transactions becomes money capital, a starting point for the fundamental movement of industrial capital.
普通货币转化为货币资本具有深远含义。由于货币是价值的独立代表并且总是能够购买，货币是比商品资本或生产资本更一般的循环起点。只要资本的循环运动是社会经济再生产的特征形式，货币就购买生产资料、雇用工人，并导致利润的生产。

The transformation of plain money into money capital has profound implications. Since money is the independent representative of value and can always buy, money is a more general starting point for the circuit than either commodity or productive capital. As long as the circular movement of capital is the characteristic form of society’s economic reproduction, money buys means of production, hires workers, and results in the production of profit.

马克思对生息资本的第一种分析路径概括于脚注4提到的《资本论》各章中，并遵循古典经济学家的精神。它声称，在资本主义条件下，货币获得了“执行资本职能”的特殊使用价值。这是一种纯粹资本主义的“使用价值”，即能够从头开始启动资本循环，或扩张既有循环，从而生产利润。其含义是深远的：因为拥有这种特殊使用价值，货币可以作为特殊商品来交易——换言之，作为生息资本；既然它是特殊商品，生息资本的价格也是特殊的，即利息率。

Marx’s first approach to interest-bearing capital, summed up in the chapters of Capital mentioned in footnote 4 and following the spirit of classical economists, claimed that, under capitalist conditions, money acquires the peculiar use value ‘to function as capital’.

This is a purely capitalist ‘use value’, namely to be able either to initiate the circuit of capital ab ovo, or to expand existing circuits, and thus to produce profits. The implications are profound: because it possesses this peculiar use value, money could be traded as a peculiar commodity – in other words, as interest-bearing capital; since it is a peculiar commodity, the price of interest-bearing capital is also peculiar, i.e. it is the rate of interest.

要更精确地界定生息资本的“特殊”价格，就必须更充分地说明生息资本的“使用价值”。这可以简单地表述为“货币一般为使用者生产平均利润的能力”。于是，按照马克思著作中的这一脉络，生息资本随着货币的“平均利润生成能力”被买卖而形成。这是一种“特殊”的交易，因为作为潜在平均利润生成能力承担者的货币资本，其所有权仍留在卖者手中。因此生息资本是被借入和贷出，而不是被买入和卖出。所有者在一定时期内让渡货币资本（即贷出它）所获得的报酬，是平均产生的利润的一部分，即利息。

To define the ‘peculiar’ price of interest-bearing capital with greater precision, it is necessary more fully to specify the ‘use value’ of interest-bearing capital. This could be simply done as ‘the ability of money in general to produce the average profit for its user’. Thus, according to this strand of Marx’s work, interest-bearing capital is formed as the ‘average-profit-generating capacity’ of money is bought and sold. This is a ‘peculiar’ trade because the ownership of money capital as the bearer of the capacity potentially to generate average profit remains with the seller. Consequently, interest-bearing capital is borrowed and lent rather than bought and sold. The owner’s reward for parting with money capital for a specific period of time (i.e. lending it) is a share of the profits generated on average, that is, interest.

children: 概括地说，马克思对生息资本的第一种分析路径声称，在资本主义条件下，货币拥有能够生成平均利润的“特殊”使用价值；因此一笔货币的所有者可以暂时让渡它以换取潜在利润的一部分。正如古典经济学家所论证的，贷出者预付资本，但不“费心”把它直接用于利润的生产。用马克思自己的话说：

To recap, Marx’s first approach to interest-bearing capital claims that, under capitalist conditions, money possesses the ‘peculiar’ use value of being able to generate average profits; hence, the owner of a sum of money could temporarily part with it for a share of the potential profit. As classical economists had argued, the lender advances capital but does not ‘take the trouble’ of employing it directly in the production of profit. In Marx’s own words,
想要把货币作为生息资本来增殖的货币所有者，把它让渡给别人，投入流通，使它作为资本成为商品；不仅对他自己来说是资本，而且对别人来说也是资本。它不只是对让渡它的人是资本，而且从一开始就是作为资本交给别人的，作为具有创造剩余价值或利润的使用价值的价值。

The owner of money who wants to valorise this as interest-bearing capital parts with it to someone else, puts it into circulation, makes it into a commodity as capital; as capital not only for himself but also for others. It is not simply capital for the person who alienates it, but it is made over to the other person as capital right from the start, as value that possesses the use-value of creating surplus-value or profit.
在这一分析路径内并运用生息资本公式，可以认为“货币资本家”向“职能资本家”预付生息资本，并以利息作为报酬，利息是利润的一部分。余额归“职能资本家”，即“企业主利润”。

Within this approach and by using the formula of interest-bearing capital, it could be argued that the ‘monied’ capitalist advances interest-bearing capital to the ‘functioning’ capitalist and is rewarded with interest, which is a share of the profits. The remainder accrues to the ‘functioning’ capitalist and is the ‘profit of enterprise’.

于是利息与企业主利润之间会形成对立：它起初只是总利润的纯粹量的分割，随后却成为两种收入形式之间的质的区别。利息是纯粹因为拥有资本而归于其接受者的收入，企业主利润则是纯粹因为执行资本家职能、组织生产而归于其接受者的收入。企业主利润甚至可能被设想为资本家管理与监督的工资，尽管严格说来这并不正确，因为企业主利润总是包含来自剥削劳动力的剩余价值。简言之，本着古典经济学家的精神，马克思把利息与企业主利润视为两种收入来源，它们催生资本家阶级中两个不同且对立的阶层：一方占有的剩余价值越多，留给另一方的就越少。

Consequently, there would be an opposition between interest and profit of enterprise that would start as a purely quantitative division of total profit, but would then become a qualitative distinction between the two forms of revenue. While interest is revenue that accrues to its recipient purely because of possessing capital, profit of enterprise is revenue that accrues to its recipient purely because of functioning as a capitalist and organising production. Profit of enterprise might even be conceived of as the wages of capitalist management and supervision even though, strictly speaking, that would be incorrect, since profit of enterprise always incorporates surplus value from the exploitation of labor power. In short, and in the spirit of classical economists, Marx treated interest and profit of enterprise as two sources of revenue that give rise to two distinct and antagonistic sections of the capitalist class: the more surplus value that is appropriated by one, the less that would remain for the other.
马克思对生息资本的第一种分析路径存在若干问题，其中包括以下关于资本主义经济中信用与金融的基本观察：
Marx’s first approach to interest-bearing capital is problematic for several reasons, including the following fundamental observations about credit and finance in a capitalist economy:
第一，假定一个纯粹的“职能资本家”只拥有投资项目而没有货币，是观念上的抽象。实践中，借入资本的资本家除借入部分外通常也拥有一些自有资本。需要一个更好的假设，以便更容易地把握自有资本与借入资本相混合的观念，即杠杆或负债经营的观念。

First, the assumption of a pure ‘functioning’ capitalist, who simply possesses an investment project but has no money, is ideally abstract. In practice, borrowing capitalists typically possess some of their own capital in addition to what they borrow. A better assumption is needed that could more easily capture the notion of mixing own and borrowed capital, i.e. of leverage, or gearing.

第二，实践中以利息形式获得的收入也倾向于归于产业资本家和商业资本家，更不用说广大的非资本主义社会阶层。几乎没有证据表明利息实际充当了某个社会群体的排他性基础。因此，贷出资本家与借入资本家之间无疑存在的彼此独立且常常对立的利益，无法用资本家阶级中假定的“职能”部分与“货币”部分相对抗来加以令人满意的分析。要说明货币贷出领域中资本家之间的这些冲突以及共生关系，需要更好的理论表述。为此，必须把生息资本的创造、预付与偿还视为产业资本积累过程的内在组成部分。

Second, revenue in the form of interest in practice tends to accrue also to industrial and commercial capitalists, not to mention broad swathes of non-capitalist social layers. There is little evidence that interest actually serves as the exclusive foundation of a social group. Consequently, the separate, and often opposing, interests that undoubtedly exist among lending and borrowing capitalists could not be satisfactorily analysed in terms of the ‘functioning’ section of the capitalist class presumably confronting the ‘monied’ section. A better theoretical formulation is necessary to account for these conflicts, but also for the symbiotic relations, among capitalists in the realm of lending money. To this purpose, it would be necessary to consider the creation, advance, and repayment of interest-bearing capital as integral parts of the process of accumulating industrial capital.
第三，正如马克思本人指出的，生息资本是一种“洪水期前的”资本形式，也存在于古代前资本主义社会中。
因此，如果通过考察贷出的“货币资本家”与借入的“职能资本家”之间假定的关系来分析生息资本的性质，就很难识别生息资本的现代性质与古代性质之间的差别。这不仅是历史分析的问题，也关系到对资本主义关系尚未完全占主导地位的发展中国家利息与信用的分析。
Third, and as Marx himself pointed out, interest-bearing capital is an ‘antediluvian’ form of capital, also found in ancient pre-capitalist societies.

Thus, if the nature of interest-bearing capital was analysed by examining the putative relationship between a lending ‘monied’ capitalist and a borrowing ‘functioning’ capitalist, it would be hard to identify the difference between the modern and the ancient character of interest-bearing capital. This is not merely a matter of historical analysis, but has relevance for the analysis of interest and credit in developing countries where capitalist relations are not yet entirely dominant.

第四，如果分析停留在两个个人之间的交易层面，即使把一方当作“货币资本家”、另一方当作“职能资本家”，生息资本的性质也会在很大程度上表现为贷出者的意图与借入者的理解的问题。即使我们假定（或把马克思解释为假定）交易发生在资本主义积累的社会背景之下，这种分析仍带有断言的味道。并不存在压倒性的必然要求，使借入资本家必须是把货币用于创造剩余价值的“职能资本家”才能偿还。原则上，借入者可以把货币用于非生产性用途，但只要获得其他货币来源的渠道有保障，就仍能归还货币并支付利息。这在信用与金融领域是常见做法。

Fourth, if analysis remained at the level of transactions between two individuals, even when one was taken as a ‘monied’ and the other as a ‘functioning’ capitalist, the character of interest-bearing capital would appear largely as a matter of the intentions of the lender and of the understanding of the borrower. Even if we assumed (or interpreted Marx as assuming) that the transaction occurred against the social background of capitalist accumulation, the analysis would still smack of assertion. There is no overwhelming requirement for the borrowing capitalist to be a ‘functioning’ capitalist deploying the money in creating surplus value to be able to repay. In principle, the borrower could employ the money unproductively but still remain able to return it plus interest, if access to other sources of money was guaranteed. This is common practice in the field of credit and finance.
第五，一个简单的观察会使分析困难雪上加霜：如果假定货币普遍拥有能够生成平均利润率的使用价值，那么货币所有者不去实现这种使用价值而满足于利息，就几乎不可信。毕竟，把货币生产性地运用，是“消费”这种假定的“剩余价值”的另一种方式，而不是把它作为贷款出售。尽管同为资本家，是什么把一类货币所有者同另一类区别开来？答案必须比斯密那个显然肤浅的论点更深刻，即贷出者“不愿费心”积极运用自己的货币。

Fifth, the analytical difficulty would be compounded by the simple observation that if money were assumed generally to possess the use value of being able to generate the average rate of profit, it would hardly be credible for the owner of money not to realise this use value but to remain satisfied with interest. For, after all, deploying the money productively would be another way of ‘consuming’ this putative ‘surplus value’ instead of selling it as a loan. What is it that differentiates one type of money owner from another, despite both being capitalists? The answer must be deeper than Smith’s evidently superficial argument that the lenders ‘could not be at the trouble of employing’ their money actively.
总之，如果分析聚焦于假定的“货币资本家”与“职能资本家”之间的关系，那么马克思的如下猜想——生息资本在“实现了其生产剩余价值的使用价值”后回流的条件下从所有者那里让渡出去——在逻辑上完全无法证明。
对信用与生息资本的第一种分析路径存在严重缺陷。

In sum, Marx’s conjecture that interest-bearing capital is alienated from its owner on condition that it returns having ‘realised its use-value of producing surplus-value’ is quite impossible to demonstrate logically if analysis focuses on the relation between putative ‘monied’ and ‘functioning’ capitalists.
The first approach to credit and interest-bearing capital is seriously deficient.

更有说服力的假设是：在资本家之间的货币贷出中，货币所有者对生成剩余价值的潜力并不拥有排他性的所有权，因为这种潜力也已存在于借入者的经营计划中。此外，贷出的货币很可能在贷出者手中闲置已久，因为如果存在现实的平均利润机会，多半早已被利用。照此看来，利息似乎只是货币所有者因让渡自己的财产而获得的报酬。获得这种报酬的可能性并不为资本主义条件所特有，而可以在许多不同的社会制度中找到。这为马克思著作中对生息资本的第二种分析路径提供了更好的基础。

It is more persuasive to assume that in the lending of money among capitalists, the owner of money does not have exclusive property over the potential to generate surplus value, since the latter already also exists in the business plans of the borrower. Moreover, the money that is lent has probably lain idle in the lender’s hands, given that realistic opportunities for average profit making would probably have been exploited, had they existed. Approached in this way, interest would appear to be simply a reward received by the owner of money for parting with his or her property. The possibility of receiving this reward is not specific to capitalist conditions but could be found in many different social systems. This is a better foundation for the second approach to interest-bearing capital in Marx’s work.

zh: 2 闲置货币、资本周转与生息资本
en: 2 Idle Money, the Turnover of Capital, and Interest-Bearing Capital

children: 马克思著作中对生息资本的另一种分析路径十分明显，尽管它与已讨论的那一种不安地共存。它有两个基本要素。
The alternative approach to interest-bearing capital in Marx’s work is abundantly evident, although it coexists uneasily with the one already discussed. There are two fundamental elements to it.
第一，马克思在《资本论》第二卷考察社会总资本的再生产时表明，闲置货币的集中（货币贮藏）由产业资本家及其他人系统地产生并持有。它们都是纯粹资本主义的货币贮藏形式，包括暂时闲置的利润、固定资本的折旧基金、预防性准备，以及使资本在生产与流通交替中得以连续周转的准备。

First, while examining the reproduction of the total social capital in the second volume of Capital, Marx showed that concentrations of idle money (money hoards) are systematically generated and held by industrial capitalists and others. They are all purely capitalist forms of money hoarding and include temporarily idle profits, the depreciation funds of fixed capital, precautionary reserves, and reserves that allow for the continuous turnover of capital as production and circulation alternate.
第二，同样在《资本论》第二卷中，马克思指出，在资本循环的运转过程中（即在资本周转过程中）定期产生的闲置货币，构成资本主义信用体系的基础。信用体系是一套社会机制，它动员资本周转中产生的闲置货币，通过把它转化为生息（借贷）资本而使之成为同质商品，并把它重新导向积累。贷出者与借入者的意图，以及借贷资本实际被投入的用途，在这方面完全无关紧要。
Second, and also in the second volume of
Capital

, Marx indicated that idle money which is regularly created as the circuit of capital is traversed (i.e. in the course of the turnover of capital) serves as a foundation for the capitalist credit system. The credit system is a set of social mechanisms that mobilise idle money generated in the turnover of capital, transform it into a homogeneous commodity by turning it into interest-bearing (loanable) capital, and redirect it to accumulation. The intentions of lender and borrower, and the uses to which loanable capital is actually put, are entirely irrelevant in this respect.
换言之，资本主义经济的信用体系包含银行与金融市场等一套机构，完成产业资本家与商业资本家之间内部产生的闲置资金的再配置。通过体系机制贷出的货币已经变成生息资本，并要求支付利息。鉴于实际积累的存在通常吸收了信用体系预付的生息资本的大部分，利息作为一种收入形式便作为定期生产的利润的一部分而获得客观的社会基础。

Put differently, the credit system of a capitalist economy comprises a set of institutions, such as banks and financial markets, that accomplish the reallocation of internally generated spare funds among industrial and commercial capitalists. The money that is lent through the system’s mechanisms has already become interest-bearing capital and commands the payment of interest. Given the existence of real accumulation that typically absorbs the bulk of interest-bearing capital advanced by the credit system, interest as a form of revenue acquires an objective social foundation as a share of regularly produced profit.
在这一分析路径中，借贷资本贷出的复杂过程代表闲置资金的再配置和剩余价值在若干“职能”资本之间的再分配，而不是资本家阶级“货币”部分资本的预付与报酬。利息支付是剩余价值在资本家之间的再分配，以同一批资本家先前产生的闲置货币为基础。利息率的运动反映积累正常进程中生息资本的需求与供给。利息能够而且确实归于一切产业资本与商业资本，并不为某个独特社会群体提供基础。

In this approach, the complex process of lending loanable capital stands for the reallocation of spare funds and the redistribution of surplus value among several ‘functioning’ capitals, rather than for the advance and remuneration of the capital of the ‘monied’ section of the capitalist class. Interest payments are a redistribution of surplus value among capitalists, based on the prior generation of idle money by the same capitalists. The motion of the rate of interest reflects the demand for and supply of interest-bearing capital in the normal course of accumulation. Interest could, and does, accrue to all industrial and commercial capitals, and does not provide a foundation for a distinct social group.
以这种方式提出问题，也允许生息资本由工人及其他社会群体货币收入中暂时闲置的部分形成。
信用体系能够集中社会表面上的一切闲置货币额，恰恰因为它已经是一套专门从事闲置货币集中与预付的社会机制，其客观社会基础在于社会总资本的周转。
Posing the issue in this manner allows for interest-bearing capital also to be created out of the temporarily idle parts of the money revenue of workers and other social groups.

The credit system is able to concentrate all spare sums of money across the surface of society precisely because it already is a set of social mechanisms specialising in the concentration and advance of idle money with an objective social basis in the turnover of the total social capital.
同理，信用体系对生息资本的预付不必只指向实际的资本主义积累，也可以指向不生产剩余价值的其他活动。广义地看，利息不仅是积累中产生的剩余价值的一部分，也是归于全社会借入者货币收入的一部分。例如，如果一个国家既有相当规模的小农阶级，又有发达的资本主义生产方式，信用体系的做法就可以提供一种从农民那里系统榨取货币剩余的机制。

Analogously, the advance of interest-bearing capital by the credit system need not be directed exclusively toward real capitalist accumulation but may also be directed toward other activities that do not produce surplus value. Seen broadly, interest is not only a portion of the surplus value generated in accumulation, but also a part of money income accruing to borrowers across society. If a country contained a sizeable smallholding peasantry as well as a developed capitalist mode of production, for instance, the practices of the credit system could provide a mechanism for the systematic extraction of monetary surpluses from the peasantry.

从这一视角看，尽管生息资本在资本周转中拥有客观的社会基础，它在理论上却被置于与资本主义积累相隔一层的位置。毕竟，暂时闲置的货币通过信用体系机制转化为生息资本，发生在积累过程之外，尽管它源于积累并回归积累。由此，信用体系的活动与生息资本的特征性运动拥有相对于实际积累的一定程度的相对自主性。这种自主性表现在信用机构能够从社会各部分收集闲置货币，也表现在即使实际积累面临困难它们仍能继续获利。信用体系的相对自主性可能是解释资本主义经济不稳定的重要因素。不过，尽管拥有相对自主性，信用体系的客观基础仍由资本主义企业产生的闲置货币提供，这一事实意味着其活动最终服从资本主义积累的要求。

From this perspective, and despite possessing an objective social foundation in the turnover of capital, interest-bearing capital is theoretically posited at one remove from capitalist accumulation. After all, the transformation of temporarily idle money into interest-bearing capital through the mechanisms of the credit system occurs outside the process of accumulation, despite deriving from and returning to the latter. It follows that the operations of the credit system and the characteristic motion of interest-bearing capital possess a degree of relative autonomy from real accumulation. This autonomy is manifested in the ability of credit institutions to collect spare money from all sections of society, as well as in their ability to continue making profits even if real accumulation faces difficulties. The relative autonomy of the credit system could be an important factor in explaining capitalist economic instability. Nevertheless, despite its relative autonomy, the fact that its objective foundation is provided by the idle money generated by capitalist enterprises means that the operations of the credit system ultimately comply with the requirements of capitalist accumulation.
马克思著作中对生息资本的第二种分析路径相对第一种有若干优势，包括：
The second approach to interest-bearing capital in Marx’s work has several advantages over the first, including the following:
第一，它允许把信用体系作为一套在资本主义社会中系统形成生息资本的社会机制加以结构化分析。
First, it allows for a structured analysis of the credit system as a set of social mechanisms that systematically form interest-bearing capital in a capitalist society.
第二，它为分析向工人、资本家及其他社会阶级出于非生产目的的贷出提供了坚实的理论基础，而这种贷出是成熟资本主义的特征。

Second, it provides a sound theoretical foundation for the analysis of lending for nonproductive purposes to workers, capitalists, and other social classes, which is characteristic of mature capitalism.
第三，它与日常观察相吻合：“职能”资本主义企业常常能够通过把闲置资金贷给别人而赚取可观的利息。
Third, it coheres with the casual observation that ‘functioning’ capitalist enterprises are often able to earn substantial sums of interest by lending their spare funds to others.
最后，它允许分析出于投资目的但可能无法产生预期回报的贷出。无论货币实际被投入何种用途，贷出者仍可以要求支付利息，因为信用体系已经把借入的货币转化为生息资本。此外，尽管利息在利润的产生中获得客观的社会基础，它仍然是让渡贷出者财产的报酬。因此，利息潜在地可以从全社会的一切货币收入中榨取，无论这些收入最终能否归结为剩余价值。

Finally, it allows for the analysis of lending that is for investment purposes but might fail to generate the expected returns. Regardless of the use to which the money has actually been put, the lender could still command the payment of interest since the credit system has already transformed the borrowed money into interest-bearing capital. Despite acquiring an objective social foundation in the generation of profit, moreover, interest remains a reward for parting with the lender’s property. Thus, interest could be potentially extracted from all money revenues across society, regardless of whether these could be ultimately reduced to surplus value.

zh: 3 资本周转中闲置货币的产生
en: 3 The Generation of Idle Money in the Turnover of Capital

children: 价值在资本循环的正常运转过程中系统地脱离循环并以货币形式闲置，有若干结构性原因。换言之，循环不断“泄漏”价值，这些“泄漏”表现为与在循环中运转的价值并行持有的货币额。“泄漏”的（或脱离的）价值处于静止状态，近似于货币贮藏。的确，如果为分析起见假定货币纯粹是金属货币且不存在信用体系，那么脱离循环的价值只能是货币贮藏。

There are several structural reasons why value systematically abandons the circuit of capital in the normal course of its traverse and becomes idle in the money form. To put it differently, the circuit constantly ‘leaks’ value, the ‘leaks’ appearing as sums of money held alongside value traversing the circuit. ‘Leaked’ (or disengaged) value is a state of rest and approximates a money hoard. Indeed, if it were assumed for the sake of analysis that money was purely metallic and that there was no credit system, value disengaged from the circuit could only be a money hoard.
应当强调，马克思对货币贮藏的分析路径与凯恩斯主义的流动性偏好有实质区别。后者最终依赖未经解释的个人心理动机来贮藏货币。
马克思的分析中没有这类动机：当资本在循环中运转时，出于循环本身的客观原因而发生贮藏。此外，从循环“泄漏”并不立即且必然意味着价值流的收缩。价值以货币形式、在有限时间内脱离循环，常常是为了使循环流整体维持给定规模。资本可以在定期形成并解除贮藏的同时，继续在同一水平上再生产自身。

It should be stressed that Marx’s approach to money hoarding differs substantially from Keynesian liquidity preference. The latter ultimately relies on unexplained personal and psychological motivations for the hoarding of money.

There are no such motivations in Marx’s analysis: Hoarding takes place as capital traverses the circuit for objective reasons pertaining to the circuit itself. Furthermore, ‘leaks’ from the circuit do not imply the shrinking of the flow of value immediately and necessarily. Value is disengaged from the circuit in the money form and for limited periods of time, frequently in order to enable the circular flow as a whole to maintain a given size. Capital can continue to reproduce itself at the same level while regularly forming and dissolving hoards.
据此，资本循环中有四个贮藏来源：
In this light, there are four sources of hoarding in the circuit of capital:
第一，有纯粹与流通相联系的贮藏。在M – c阶段，资本家必须形成预防性贮藏以应付不可预见的支付与购买，并应对资本主义流通中不可避免的价格波动。这些是“准备基金”，是“执行职能的货币资本的一部分”，是资本家必须在循环最开始就持有的一种货币准备。
不过，在M – c与c′ – M′阶段，即在流通领域，生产资料与劳动力的逐渐购买以及成品的逐渐出售也产生货币贮藏。

First, there are hoards associated purely with circulation. At stage M – c, the capitalists have to form precautionary hoards to meet unforeseen payments and purchases, as well as confronting the inevitable price fluctuations of capitalist circulation. These are ‘reserve funds’, a ‘part of the functioning money capital’, and a type of money reserve that the capitalist must hold at the very beginning of the circuit.

Still, at stages M – c and c′ – M′, i.e. in the sphere of circulation, the gradual purchase of means of production and labour power and the gradual sale of the finished product also result in money hoards.

children: 第二，有与生产相联系的贮藏。固定资本（机器、厂房与设备）在资本周转的多次重复中逐渐释放其价值。在达到足以再投资的最小规模之前——例如更换用旧的机器——脱离的价值会形成贮藏，即折旧基金。对马克思而言，这些折旧基金对单个资本家最明显的用途，是作为临时基金用于对运转中的固定资本进行各种修理。

Second, there are hoards associated with production. Fixed capital (machinery, plant, and equipment) releases its value gradually and over several repetitions of the turnover of capital. Until a minimum size sufficient for reinvestment would have been reached – for instance, to replace used-up machinery – the disengaged value would form a hoard, i.e. a depreciation fund. For Marx, the most obvious use of these depreciation funds for the individual capitalist would be as a temporary fund from which to accomplish various repairs on the operating fixed capital.
第三，仍与生产相关，货币贮藏也随着利润的积累并变得可用于再投资而形成。在这些利润达到与再生产的物质特征相适应的最小规模之前，它们会作为资本家持有的货币基金而积累。折旧基金与积累的利润都是典型的资本主义贮藏，因为它们植根于资本主义生产。

Third, and still related to production, money hoards are also formed as profits accrue and become available for reinvestment. Until such profits reached a minimum size consistent with the material characteristics of reproduction, they would accumulate as money funds held by the capitalist. Both depreciation funds and accumulated profits are typically capitalist hoards since they have their roots in capitalist production.
最后，有与生产和流通的统一、即与资本周转整体相联系的贮藏。马克思把这种贮藏形成称为“周转机制”，并投入相当精力确定其技术特征，从循环的时间维度开始。

具体而言，M – c与c′ – M′两个阶段共同构成资本的流通，走完这一流通需要一段确定的时间，称为流通期间；同理，走完P阶段则产生生产期间。处于流通中的那部分资本（即正在出售的商品产出，以及寻求投入并支付工资的货币资本）已暂时离开生产，因而不再生产剩余价值。然而资本家处于竞争压力之下，必须使固定资本持续使用，从而维持生产（产出与剩余价值两者）的连续性。由此直接得出：在资本周转的最开始，资本家必须持有用于购买投入和支付工资的货币资本，其数额超出单个生产期间的需要。的确，资本家必须拥有足够的货币资本准备，以维持生产直到商品产出的销售收入变得定期而稳定。

Finally, there are hoards associated with the unity of production and circulation, or with the turnover of capital as a whole. Marx called this type of hoard formation ‘the mechanism of the turnover’ and devoted considerable effort to ascertaining its technical characteristics, starting with the time dimension of the circuit.

Specifically, the stages M – c and c′ – M′ taken together form the circulation of capital, traversing which would require a definite period of time, called the circulation period; the traverse of stage P would, analogously, give rise to the production period. The part of capital that would be traversing circulation (i.e. commodity output in the process of being sold, and money capital seeking inputs and paying wages) would have temporarily left production and therefore it would not be producing surplus value. The capitalist, however, would be under competitive pressure to keep fixed capital in continuous use and thus to maintain the continuity of production (of both output and surplus value). It follows immediately that at the very start of the turnover of capital, the capitalist must hold money capital aimed at purchasing inputs and paying wages that would be in excess of the requirements of a single production period. Indeed, the capitalist must possess sufficient money capital reserves to continue production until such time as the revenues from commodity output sales would become regular.

children: 重要的是注意，除这一无可争议的结论外，马克思还试图表明，回流的销售收入的一部分就维持生产连续性而言会暂时变得多余；因此它们倾向于作为货币贮藏而积累。
马克思把这一过程称为“周转机制”。他对这一过程的讨论依赖对“流动”资本——即用于购买劳动力与原材料的资本——的生产期间与流通期间重叠模式的分析。他对这一论点的技术性证明是不正确的，下文将简要展示。尽管如此，其论证的主旨对我们的目的而言既正确又重要。

It is important to note that in addition to this indisputable conclusion, Marx also attempted to show that parts of the returning sales revenue would become temporarily redundant for the purposes of maintaining the continuity of production is concerned; hence, they tend to accumulate as money hoards.

Marx called this process the ‘mechanism of the turnover’. His discussion of it relied on the analysis of the overlapping patterns of the production period and the circulation period for ‘fluid’ capital – that is, for capital used to purchase labour power and raw materials. His technical substantiation of this argument is incorrect, as is briefly shown below. Nevertheless, the thrust of his argument was both correct and important for our purposes.

body.review: 印刷句法杂糅：'for the purposes of maintaining the continuity of production is concerned'混用'for the purposes of…'与'as far as … is concerned'两式；译文按'就维持生产连续性而言'处理。

children: 为展示“周转机制”假定的运作，马克思假定最终产出的销售“一次性”发生，而投入则逐渐购买。
这些假设的普遍性是有问题的，因为对广大行业而言最终产出的销售完全可能逐渐发生。的确，销售收入“一次性”整笔回流恐怕才是例外。无论如何，马克思随后论证，每当流通期间不是生产期间的整数倍时，随着销售收入的回流就会形成暂时闲置的货币。
原因在于，在假定条件下，每个流通期间结束时销售收入的突然回流，必然发生在某个生产期间已部分流逝之后。因此在马克思看来，销售收入的一部分在该期间内为维持生产连续性而暂时变得不必要。
To demonstrate the putative operation of the ‘mechanism of the turnover’, Marx assumed that the sale of final output took place ‘at one stroke’, while inputs were purchased gradually.

The generality of these assumptions is problematic since the sale of final output could very well take place gradually for a broad range of industries. Indeed, it is probably the exception for sales revenue to accrue in one lump sum ‘at a stroke’. Be that as it may, Marx subsequently argued that whenever the circulation period was not an exact multiple of the production period, temporarily idle money would be formed as the sales revenue accrued.

The reason would be that under the assumed conditions, the sudden accrual of the sales revenue at the end of each circulation period would necessarily take place after a production period would have already lapsed in part. Hence, it seemed to Marx, a part of the sales revenue would become temporarily unnecessary to finance the continuity of production during that period.
即使在马克思假设的框架内，这一结论也不普遍正确。“一次性”回流的已售产出价值（在一个生产期间内生产）按设定等于运转一个生产期间所必需的资本价值。尽管如此，回流的货币资本是流动的，可以分摊到本期与下一期生产。如果要维持生产连续性，并且给定流通期间的严格规则性（马克思所假定的），那么未来每个相继流通期间结束时回流的销售收入整笔款项，对于维持生产连续性都是完全必要的，其中任何部分都不会暂时闲置。

This conclusion is not generally correct, even within the framework of Marx’s assumptions. The value of the sold output (produced in one production period) that accrues ‘at a stroke’ is, by construction, equal to the value of the capital necessary to run one production period. Nevertheless, the accruing money capital is fluid and could be spread over the present and the next period of production. If continuity of production is to be maintained, and given strict regularity of the circulation period (which is assumed by Marx), the lumps of sales revenue accruing at the end of each successive circulation period in the future would be entirely necessary in order to maintain the continuity production and no part of them would be temporarily idle.

body.review: 印刷脱漏of：'maintain the continuity production'应为'maintain the continuity of production'；译文按完整结构处理。

children: 马克思认为问题取决于流通期间是否为生产期间的整数倍，这是错误的。的确，生产期间与流通期间的相对长度对维持生产连续性完全无关。当然，如果流通期间高度不规则且不确定，销售收入整笔款项的一部分很可能暂时变得多余，因为资本家无论如何都会动用闲置资金维持生产的连续性。但这一结果来自销售回报的不确定性，而不是来自生产时间与流通时间的相互作用——后者才是马克思“周转机制”所指的东西。

Marx is wrong to think that the issue depends on whether the circulation period is an exact multiple of the production period, or not. Indeed, the relative lengths of the production period and the circulation period are altogether irrelevant to maintaining the continuity of production. It is, of course, true that, if the circulation period were highly irregular and uncertain, a part of the lump of sales revenue would probably become temporarily redundant, since capitalists would have used spare funds to keep production continuous in any case. This result, however, would arise from the uncertainty of sales returns and not from the interplay of production and circulation time, which is what Marx had in mind with ‘the mechanism of turnover’.

因此，销售回报的不确定与不规则才是挽救马克思论证有效内核的途径，即闲置货币会作为维持资本周转连续性的结果而形成。资本家不可避免地面对可变且不可预测的销售进款流，其时间必然不同于购买生产资本（包括支付工资）的支出流，而后者几乎同样可变且不可预测。给定维持生产连续性的竞争压力，资本家需要持有支付手段的预防性准备以弥补缺口。这种“周转准备”使资本家能够熨平收支流时间上的差异、生产与流通条件的突然变化以及其他不规则性。“周转准备”不是马克思所认为的周转过程中“释放”的货币，而是必须在循环开始时就存在、以确保资本周转连续性的准备。

Consequently, uncertainty and irregularity of sales returns would be the way to rescue the valid kernel of Marx’s argument, namely that idle money would be formed as a result of maintaining the continuity of the turnover of capital. Capitalists are inevitably confronted with variable and unpredictable flows of sales proceeds, the timing of which would necessarily be different from the scarcely less variable and unpredictable outlays to purchase productive capital (including the payment of wages). Given the competitive pressure to maintain the continuity of production, capitalists would need to hold a precautionary reserve of means of payment to cover shortfalls. This ‘turnover reserve’ would allow the capitalists to iron out disparities in the timing of flows of receipts and expenditures, sudden changes in production and circulation conditions, and other irregularities. The ‘turnover reserve’ would not be money ‘released’ in the course of turnover, as Marx thought, but rather a reserve that must be present at the start of the circuit to ensure the continuity of the turnover of capital.
如前所述，价值以各种预防性准备以及暂时未利用的利润和折旧基金的形式定期脱离循环，为资本主义条件下的信用体系提供社会基础。信用体系收集“泄漏”的价值，把它转化为生息资本，并把它导回实际积累。据此，生息资本并不永久停留在社会总资本循环之内。相反，它在循环之外系统形成，随后不断进入和退出循环。这一点对于生息资本报酬的全部意义，将在下文对马克思的商人资本分析作简要而必要的离题讨论之后，再加以阐述。

As has already been noted, the regular disengagement of value from the circuit in the form of various precautionary reserves, as well as temporarily unutilised profits and a depreciation fund, would provide the social foundation for the credit system under capitalist conditions. The credit system collects ‘leaked’ value, transforms it into interest-bearing capital, and channels it back into real accumulation. By this token, interest-bearing capital does not remain permanently within the circuit of the total social capital. Rather, it is systematically formed outside the circuit, subsequently to enter and exit it continually. The full significance of this point for the remuneration of interest-bearing capital is discussed below, after a brief and necessary digression on Marx’s analysis of merchants’ capital.
The Rate of Interest and the Rate of Profit
商人资本包括商业资本与货币经营资本，是一种与生息资本密切联系的古老资本形式。
在资本主义经济中，商业资本买卖商品，完全停留在交换领域。商业利润通过转售商人最初购买的商品而获得，而不是通过雇用和剥削劳动力。商业资本的社会职能是为资本整体最小化商品流通费用。
因此，商业资本按与产业资本相同的比例（即获得平均利润率）从总剩余价值中获得报酬，具有客观依据。
Merchants’ capital, comprising commercial and money-dealing capital, is an ancient form of capital closely linked to interest-bearing capital.

In a capitalist economy, commercial capital buys and sells commodities, remaining entirely within the sphere of exchange. Commercial profit accrues through the resale of commodities originally bought by merchants, rather than through the employment and exploitation of labour power. The social function of commercial capital is to minimise the costs of circulating commodities for capital as a whole.

Consequently, there are objective grounds for the remuneration of commercial capital out of total surplus value on the same pro rata basis as industrial capital (i.e. receiving the average rate of profit).
同理，货币经营资本是专门管理交换领域中必然存在的货币的资本形式，因而也完全停留在流通领域。给定广泛的资本主义流通，必须记账、保管存款、划转货币额，尤其必须把一国货币兑换成另一国货币。货币经营资本在社会规模上降低这些活动的费用，因而按与商业资本和产业资本相同的基础获得报酬，即获得平均利润率。随着资本主义信用体系的成长与发展，银行倾向于占有货币经营资本的职能，导致它作为独立资本形式消失。

Along similar lines, money-dealing capital is a form of capital that specialises in managing the money that is necessarily present in the sphere of exchange, and thus it also remains entirely within the sphere of circulation. Given extensive capitalist circulation, accounts have to be kept, deposits have to be safeguarded, sums of money transferred, and, above all, money of one nationality has to be changed into money of another. Money-dealing capital reduces the costs of these activities on a social scale and, consequently, it is remunerated on the same basis as commercial and industrial capital, i.e. it draws the average rate of profit. As the capitalist credit system grows and develops, banks tend to appropriate the functions of money-dealing capital, leading to its disappearance as an independent form of capital.
商业资本与货币经营资本（以及银行资本，就它是货币经营资本的发达和变形形式而言）都是社会总资本循环中流通领域的内在组成部分。它们最小化流通费用，并且作为其内在运动的一部分不离开循环。由于它们是循环的内在资本，它们以与产业资本相同的地位参与总剩余价值的再分配。简言之，它们参与平均利润率的形成。

Both commercial and money-dealing capital (and also banking capital, insofar as it is a developed and altered form of money-dealing capital) are integral parts of the sphere of circulation within the circuit of the total social capital. They minimise the costs of circulation and do not leave the circuit as part of their intrinsic movement. Since they are capitals integral to the circuit, they take part in the redistribution of total surplus value on the same footing as industrial capital. In short, they participate in the formation of the average rate of profit.
另一方面，生息资本在循环之外不断形成，进入并退出循环。换言之，生息资本动员积累过程中存在的闲置货币基金，把它们在其他循环内在资本之间再配置（从而贡献于剩余价值的社会生产）。
结果，生息资本也赚取总剩余价值的一部分，但基础不同于产业、商业与货币经营（或银行）资本。生息资本不参与平均利润率的规定，而是赚取利息。

Interest-bearing capital, on the other hand, is continually formed outside the circuit, entering and exiting the latter. Put differently, interest-bearing capital mobilises the spare money funds present in the course of accumulation, reallocating these among other capitals integral to the circuit (thus contributing to the social production of surplus value).

As a result, interest-bearing capital also earns a share of the total surplus value, but not on the same basis as industrial, commercial, and money-dealing (or banking) capital. Interestbearing capital does not take part in the determination of the average rate of profit but earns interest instead.
这种对生息资本性质的分析路径使人更容易理解马克思的论断：平均利润率通常高于平均利息率，并通常构成其上限（资本主义商业周期的某些时刻除外）。
这是马克思主义经济学的特征性论断，与新古典主义和凯恩斯主义完全对立，后两者都假定利润率与利息率趋于相等。对马克思主义经济学而言，这两个率的不等反映循环内在资本与从外部进入随后退出循环的资本之间的结构性差别。它也反映生息资本对产业资本产生的闲置资金的最终依赖。

This approach to the nature of interest-bearing capital makes it easier to appreciate Marx’s claim that the average rate of profit is normally higher than the average rate of interest and usually forms its upper limit (except for some moments of the capitalist business cycle).

This is a characteristic claim of Marxist economics that is in complete contrast to neoclassicism and Keynesianism, both of which postulate the tendency of the rate of profit and the rate of interest toward equality. For Marxist economics, the inequality of these two rates reflects the structural difference between capital that is integral to the circuit and a capital that enters from the outside and subsequently exits the circuit. It also reflects the ultimate dependence of interest-bearing capital on the spare funds generated by industrial capitals.

对循环内在资本而言，资本流动性原则支撑利润率的均等化。生产剩余价值所必需的社会能力在不同生产部门（包括流通特有的活动）之间不断再配置，确保参与循环运作的一切资本按比例获得报酬。鉴于前述分析，显然资本流动性原则不能以同样方式作用于生息资本与循环内在资本之间。例如，要变成生息资本，某个产业资本必须完全放弃循环，从而把自己从生成剩余价值的社会能力中移除，而不是仅仅把这种能力在不同任务间再配置。等价地，如果一笔生息资本永久地把自己转化为产业资本，它就会同时通过扩大社会总资本循环的流量、进而产生闲置货币，为自己未来的再构成建立条件。

For capitals that are integral to the circuit, the principle of the mobility of capital underpins the equalisation of the rate of profit. The social capacity necessary to produce surplus value is constantly reallocated among the different branches of production (including activities specific to circulation) ensuring the pro rata remuneration of all capitals participating in the operations of the circuit. In the light of our preceding analysis, it is clear that the principle of capital mobility cannot operate in the same manner between interest-bearing capital and capitals integral to the circuit. To become interest-bearing capital, for instance, a given industrial capital would have to abandon the circuit altogether, thereby removing itself from the social capacity to generate surplus value, rather than merely reallocating this capacity among different tasks. Equivalently, if a sum of interest-bearing capital permanently transformed itself into industrial capital, it would be simultaneously establishing the conditions for its own future reconstitution through the augmentation of the flows of the circuit of the total social capital and thus the generation of idle money.
然而显然，要完整证明利息率通常低于利润率的趋势，需要比这些一般性考虑复杂得多的分析。
以下两个因素在这方面至关重要。

It is evident, however, that the complete demonstration of the tendency of the rate of interest normally to lie below the rate of profit would require a considerably more complex analysis than these general considerations.
The following two factors are critically important in this connection.
第一，实际积累内在地沿周期性路径运动，在此过程中利息率与利润率倾向于反向运动。
这里只需指出：尽管平均利润率原则上构成平均利息率的上限，但周期中存在利息支付达到顶峰、不仅吞噬利润而且吞噬借入资本家资本本身的时刻。在那些时刻，平均利润率不构成平均利息率的上限。换言之，尽管生息资本有动员和再配置闲置资金的社会有益职能，它也可能侵蚀产业资本家的资本。这种潜在的破坏作用与生息资本相对于社会总资本循环的相对自主、部分外在的位置完全一致。
First, real accumulation inherently moves along a cyclical path, in the course of which the rate of interest and the rate of profit tend to move in opposite directions.

Suffice it to state here that although the average rate of profit in principle forms an upper limit for the average rate of interest, there are moments in the cycle when interest payments would peak and consume not just the profits but also the very capital of borrowing capitalists. At those moments, the average rate of profit would not form an upper limit for the average rate of interest. In other words, despite its socially beneficial function of mobilising and reallocating spare funds, interest-bearing capital could also eat into the capital of industrial capitalists. This potentially destructive role would be fully in line with the relatively autonomous, partly external, position of interest-bearing capital relative to the circuit of the total social capital.
第二，信用体系的制度结构及其在全社会系统动员资金的运作能力，对利息率相对于利润率的规定也极为重要。因为信用体系相对远离社会总资本再生产的物质方面（如生产技术与工人阶级的生活水平），信用流量与价格的规定在很大程度上依赖构成信用体系的金融机构的特性与性质。

Second, the institutional structure of the credit system and its operational ability systematically to mobilise funds across society also matter greatly for the determination of the rate of interest relative to the rate of profit. Because the credit system is relatively removed from the material aspects of the reproduction of the total social capital, such as the technology of production and the standard of living of the working class, determination of the flows and prices of credit would depend heavily on the peculiarities and the character of the financial institutions comprising the credit system.
换言之，社会再生产的任何客观物质方面都不反映在利息率的形成中，总利润分割为利息与企业主利润也没有客观物质基础。相反，利润率以资本主义的方式把握了为再投资生成闲置资源并在相互竞争的资本之间分享这些资源的基本过程。利润率有物质基础，即参与资本的有机构成、资本周转的长度、工作日的长度与分割。马克思对“自然”利息率观念的著名拒绝，其核心正在于这一深刻差别。

To put it differently, no objective material aspect of social reproduction is reflected in the formation of the rate of interest, and there is no objective material basis for the division of total profit into interest and profit of enterprise. By contrast, the rate of profit captures in a capitalistic way the fundamental process of generating spare resources for reinvestment and the sharing of these resources among competing capitals. There is a material foundation for the rate of profit, namely the organic composition of the participating capitals, the length of the turnover of capital, and the length and the division of the working day. This profound difference lies at the heart of Marx’s well-known rejection of the notion of a ‘natural’ rate of interest.
利息率仅仅表达总利润的一种分割，完全基于生息资本需求与供给的平衡。在资本主义商业周期过程中，利息率的运动当然可以识别出规则性，但这些规则性没有比市场行情变化更深刻的基础。利息率是一种纯粹价格，与价值规律没有必然联系。然而恰恰因此，利息率在生息资本市场上呈现出鲜明的清晰度。相反，利润率表现为资本在不同生产部门之间的运动，无法获得类似的数值清晰度。

The rate of interest simply expresses a division of total profit, based entirely on the balance of demand for and supply of interest-bearing capital. In the course of the capitalist business cycle, regularities can certainly be identified in the motion of the rate of interest, but there would be no more profound foundation for these than the alterations in the market conjuncture. The rate of interest is a pure price without a necessary relationship to the law of value. Precisely because of this, however, the rate of interest achieves a sharp clarity in the markets for interest-bearing capital. In contrast, the rate of profit, expressed as the movement of capital among different branches of production, cannot achieve a similar numerical clarity.
最后，前述分析并不意味着货币贷借形式的信用仅仅等于资本周转中产生的闲置资金的集中与再配置。信用是一种内在灵活而可塑的社会关系。在发达的信用体系中，获得信用就是持有金融机构的负债。这种负债完全可能在信用体系内被创造出来，而无需闲置资金先已从实际积累中回流。信用体系的社会角色，隔一层看是集中脱离循环的货币价值，但再隔一层看，也是对实际积累的前景作出判断以配置生息资本。

Finally, the preceding analysis does not imply that credit in the form of money lending and borrowing amounts solely to concentration and reallocation of idle funds generated in the turnover of capital. Credit is an inherently flexible and pliable social relationship. In a developed credit system, to acquire credit is to possess the liabilities of financial institutions. It is certainly possible that such liabilities could be created within the credit system without idle funds having first accrued from real accumulation. The social role of the credit system is, at one remove, to concentrate money value disengaged from the circuit, but, at a further remove, it is also to take a view on the prospects of real accumulation in order to allocate interest-bearing capital.
金融机构负债可以纯粹基于对未来回报的预期而被创造，并期望这些回报随后使负债得到验证。信用体系必然是资本主义体系无计划秩序中理性预见要素的储存库。同理，利息率的形成似乎也依赖对未来的预期与评估。在这方面，如果利息率超过预期活动的预期利润率，单个资本家通常不会借入资金。这又是马克思基本命题的一个维度：利息率通常介于零与平均利润率之间。

Financial institution liabilities could be created purely on the expectation of future returns, and in the hope that these would subsequently validate the liabilities. The credit system is necessarily a repository of elements of rational foresight within the unplanned order of the capitalist system. By the same token, the formation of the rate of interest would also appear to depend on expectations and assessments of the future. In this regard, individual capitalists would not normally borrow funds if the rate of interest exceeded the expected rate of profit on projected activities. That is yet another dimension of Marx’s fundamental proposition that the rate of interest would normally lie between zero and the average rate of profit.

zh: 新古典利息理论与最优合同设计

children: Neoclassical Theory of Interest and Optimal Contract Design
把马克思主义对生息资本的分析与近期关于贷出和银行分析基础的主流文献并置是富有教益的：这些文献纳入信息经济学，并试图为信用体系对增长与产出波动所施加的影响提供理论基础。这一理论的根基具有深刻的新古典主义性质，以方法论个人主义为特征。

It is instructive to juxtapose Marxist analysis of interest-bearing capital with the recent mainstream literature on the analytical foundations of lending and banking that incorporates the economics of information and attempts to provide theoretical foundations for the influence exercised by the credit system on growth and output fluctuations. The underpinnings of this theory are profoundly neoclassical, characterised by methodological individualism.
该文献与阿罗-德布鲁交换的一般均衡分析没有根本分歧：后者假定一切市场参与者拥有完全信息，因而不显著区分自有资本与借入资本，也不给银行等金融中介机构留下空间。相反，该文献的目标是在交换参与者信息不对称的条件下，在一般均衡框架内为信用确立分析空间。

The literature has no fundamental quarrel with the Arrow-Debreu general equilibrium analysis of exchange which, since it assumes perfect information available to all market participants, does not significantly differentiate between own capital and borrowed capital, and leaves no room for financial intermediary institutions, such as banks. Rather, the literature’s aim is to establish analytical room for credit within a general equilibrium framework, given that information is asymmetrically available to exchange participants.
这一领域的原创洞见可追溯到阿克洛夫的“次品车”论文：卖者比潜在买者更了解自己的二手车。
因此市场价格反映买者对平均质量的感知，劣质车（“次品车”）的卖者以优质车为代价获得溢价。这可能导致二手车市场的崩溃。同理，贾菲和拉塞尔认为，贷出者在贷出之前无法区分“好”借入者与“坏”借入者。
因此所收利息必须包含覆盖坏风险的溢价。此外，由于违约概率随贷款规模变化，逆向选择随之出现：“好”借入者偏好小额贷款，而“坏”借入者偏好大额贷款。
The original insight in this field goes back to Akerlof’s ‘lemons’ paper, which argues that sellers know more about their used cars than prospective buyers.

Consequently, market price reflects the buyer’s perception of average quality, and the sellers of poor cars (‘lemons’) receive a premium at the expense of high-quality cars. This might lead to a collapse of the used car market. Along similar lines, Jaffee and Russell argue that lenders cannot distinguish among ‘good’ and ‘bad’ borrowers prior to lending.

Thus, the interest charged must contain a premium to cover for the bad risks. Since, moreover, the probability of default varies with the size of the loan, adverse selection sets in: ‘Good’ borrowers prefer small loans whereas ‘bad’ borrowers prefer large loans.
略为不同的一条思路是，利兰和派尔认为企业家比贷出者更了解自己的项目。
借入的企业家通过向项目投入自有资本向市场发送项目真实价值的信号，投入额与项目风险同向变动。收集项目风险信息无法商业化进行，因为信息一旦开始交易就会公开化并很快失去价值。因此会出现金融中介：它们收集这类信息，把它直接纳入自己的资产，通过资产多样化降低风险，因而无需持有大量自有资本。
In a slightly different vein, Leland and Pyle argue that entrepreneurs know more about their projects than the lenders.

The borrowing entrepreneur signals the true value of the project to the market by dedicating an amount of his or her own capital to the project, varying directly with the project’s risk. Gathering information about project riskiness could not be done commercially because the information would become public and thus lose its value soon after it would start being traded. Consequently, financial intermediaries would emerge that collected such information, incorporated it directly into their own assets, reduced their risk by diversifying their assets, and thus had no need to not hold large amounts of their own capital.

body.review: 印刷双重否定杂糅：'had no need to not hold large amounts of their own capital'按文意应为'had no need to hold…'；译文按'无需持有大量自有资本'处理。

children: 汤森在这场争论中取得了重大突破。
在完全信息的阿罗-德布鲁世界中，典型债务合同没有存在空间——即返还贷出者一笔确定货币（本金加利息）、且不以借入者项目实际回报为条件的协议。在这个世界中，货币所有者与项目所有者订立合伙式协议、在实际项目收益实现时加以分割，平均而言比订立标准债务合同更有利。
Townsend made a significant breakthrough in this debate.

In an Arrow-Debreu world of perfect information, there would be no room for a typical debt contract – that is, for an agreement to return to the lender a certain sum of money (principal plus interest) that would not be conditional on the actual returns to the borrower’s project. In this world, it would be on average more beneficial for the owner of money to enter into a partnership-type agreement with the project owner, dividing the actual project proceeds when these materialised, instead of entering into a standard debt contract.
汤森对货币贷出存在的解释以如下假设为前提：项目所有者比货币所有者更了解项目。分割实际收益的协议会给项目所有者以隐瞒部分或全部回报来撒谎和欺骗货币所有者的激励。为避免这种道德风险，货币所有者必须监督项目所有者。然而监督是有成本的过程，因此货币所有者与项目所有者之间的最优合同安排并不显然，必须加以研究。

Townsend’s explanation for the existence of money lending is premised on the assumption that the owner of a project would know more about it than the owner of money. An agreement to divide the actual proceeds would give the project owner an incentive to lie and defraud the money owner by concealing some or all of the returns. To avoid this moral hazard, the money owner must monitor the project owner. Since, however, monitoring is a costly process, the optimal contractual arrangement between money owner and project owner is not immediately apparent and must be investigated.
汤森为这一理论问题提供了解决方案，此后又经若干学者加以精炼。

给定新古典主义的方法论个人主义，最优监督安排是使货币所有者从假定协议中获得的预期回报（从而预期效用）最大化的安排。然而监督有成本，因此产生基于为货币所有者规定固定回报的“二分式”解。如果实际收到固定回报，贷出者就不监督项目所有者，从而避免监督成本；如果未收到，项目所有者就被宣布违约（破产），实际回报受到监督，并尽可能从项目资产中收回原预付款。因此，在信息不对称的世界中，货币所有者与项目所有者之间的最优合同是附带可能的有成本违约的债务。
Townsend offered a resolution for this theoretical problem that has been subsequently refined by several others.

Given the methodological individualism of neoclassicism, the optimal monitoring arrangement would be one that maximised the expected returns (and so the expected utility) of the money owner out of the putative agreement. Monitoring, however, is costly, and thus entails a ‘dichotomous’ solution based on a fixed return specified for the money owner. If the fixed return was actually received there would be no monitoring of the project owner by the lender, thus avoiding the monitoring costs; if it was not received the project owner would be declared in default (bankruptcy), the actual returns would be monitored, and as much as possible of the original advance would be recouped out of the project’s assets. Therefore, in a world of informational asymmetry, the optimal contract between a money owner and a project owner would be debt with possible costly default.
这一关于债务性质的基本分析近年来被广泛用于推导金融中介的性质与实践的结论。例如，如果同一借入者有许多贷出者，监督的无谓成本就会以社会浪费的方式成倍增加。因此对戴蒙德而言，金融中介是监督问题内生形成的、社会上更优的解，因为它降低成本。
银行是“委托监督人”。它们与最终借入者订立、监督并执行合同；持有充分多样化的资产组合；为贷出者资产的回报提供更平滑的模式。多样化是关键，因为它使银行破产的概率极小。因此，监督成本不被各贷出者重复承担，而银行本身无需被监督。这一路径的后续扩展旨在确立银行为何可能把贷出量配给到低于市场出清水平的理由；如果某种外部冲击最初引发波动，这种做法可能助长商业波动。

This fundamental analysis of the nature of debt has been used extensively in recent years to derive conclusions about the nature and practice of financial intermediation. If there are many lenders for the same borrower, for instance, the dead-weight costs of monitoring would be multiplied in a socially wasteful way. Thus, for Diamond, financial intermediaries are an endogenously arising, socially superior, solution for the monitoring problem, since it reduces costs.

Banks are ‘delegated monitors’. They write, monitor, and enforce contracts with ultimate borrowers; they hold well-diversified portfolios; they provide a smoother pattern for the returns on lender assets. Diversification is key since it makes the probability of bank bankruptcy very small. Consequently, while the monitoring costs are not duplicated by the various lenders, the banks need not be monitored themselves. Subsequent extensions of this approach have aimed at establishing reasons why the banks themselves might ration the volume of their lending below the market-clearing levels, a practice that might contribute to business fluctuations if some external shock initially set off such fluctuations.
马克思主义政治经济学一个多世纪以来一直论证，利息来自总利润的一种约定俗成的分割——而且这种分割反映的不过是生息资本需求与供给的平衡。在这方面，现代文献重新发明了轮子，并对资本家之间信任的有害性质添加了一些完全不自知的洞见。

Marxist political economy has argued for more than a century that interest results from a conventional division of total profit – a division, moreover, that reflects nothing other than the balance of demand and supply of interest-bearing capital. In this regard, the modern literature has rediscovered the wheel, adding some entirely unselfconscious insight into the noxious nature of trust among capitalists.

主流对债务合同最优性的“证明”带有新古典主义的一切方法论标志。重要的不是世界实际如何，而是它为何偏离个人之间市场交互的理想模型。这种交互得以可能的制度与历史背景被完全排除在方程之外。这种“证明”只是逻辑游戏，同样适用于一切其他情形：一个拥有物质资源的人遇到一个拥有某种专门知识的人，交换是两者之间唯一的社会纽带。这类分析的结论中没有任何债务特有的东西，这一点从如下事实看得清楚：把其路径应用于劳动市场也会（而且确实）产生类似结果。

The mainstream ‘proof’ of the optimality of the debt contract bears all the methodological hallmarks of neoclassicism. What matters is not how the world is, but why it diverges from the ideal model of market interaction among individuals. The institutional and historical background within which such interaction becomes possible is entirely omitted from the equations. The ‘proof’ is only a game in logic, equally applicable to all other instances in which a person with a material resource meets a person with some specialist knowledge, exchange being the only social nexus between the two. That there is nothing specific to debt in the conclusions of this type of analysis is evident from the fact that similar results would (and do) arise from the application of its approach to the labour market.

基于政治经济学的分析无需“证明”“二分式”债务合同在某种意义上是最优的：以利息为目的的货币贷出，与以利润为目的的对生产的直接投资，在类属上彼此不同，这是一个社会与历史的事实。要点在于指明这种差别的精确社会内容，以及利润与利息相互作用中所涉及的社会关系。由此观之，纯粹“货币所有者”面对纯粹“项目所有者”的假设，比马克思类似的（且有问题的）“货币资本家”与“职能资本家”之分更弱。至少马克思的假设以资本家阶级各部分分享可用剩余价值的方式，赋予这一区别以确定的社会内容。尽管如此，如上文所论证的，假定纯粹的“货币所有者”与“项目所有者”仍然具有误导性。资本主义的货币贷出最好用积累本质运动中产生的闲置货币的动员来分析，尤其因为产业“职能”资本家也参与“货币”资本的预付。

Analysis based on political economy need not ‘prove’ that a ‘dichotomous’ debt contract is somehow optimal: It is a social and historical datum that the lending of money, aiming at interest, differs generically from direct investment in production, aiming at profit. The point is to specify the precise social content of this difference, as well as the social relations involved in the interaction of profit and interest. With this in mind, the assumption of a pure ‘money owner’ confronting a pure ‘project owner’ is weaker than Marx’s analogous (and problematic) distinction between a ‘monied’ and a ‘functioning’ capitalist. At least Marx’s assumption ascribed a definite social content to this distinction in terms of fractions of the capitalist class sharing out the available surplus value. Nonetheless, as has been argued above, it is still misleading to assume pure ‘money owners’ and ‘project owners’. The capitalist lending of money is best analysed in terms of the mobilisation of idle money generated in the essential motion of accumulation, not least since industrial, ‘functioning’ capitalists also partake of the advance of ‘monied’ capital.
此外，在资本主义经济中利息通常是总利润的一部分。利息率是一种纯粹价格，当信用体系就位时获得全社会的适用性；信用体系把闲置货币资本集中并导向价值扩张的社会机制。生息资本回流其所有者，表达它相对于实际积累的相对自主性、它与产业资本保持距离的关系，因而也表达它对生产过程潜在的掠夺性和本质上漠不关心的态度。

In a capitalist economy, moreover, interest is normally a share of total profit. The rate of interest is a pure price that acquires society-wide applicability when a credit system is in place, which concentrates and directs spare money capital toward the social mechanism for the expansion of value. The return of interest-bearing capital to its owner expresses its relative autonomy with respect to real accumulation, its arm’s-length relationship with the industrial capital, and hence also its potentially predatory and essentially indifferent attitude to the process of production.
贷出者与借入者之间的信息不对称，是如下区别的拙劣替代：一方面闲置货币伴随积累而变成生息资本，另一方面资本在剩余价值生产中执行职能。在新古典理论中，生息资本与产业资本之别所包含的社会规定的丰富性，以及剩余价值生产在社会再生产过程中的首要性，坍缩为一个平庸的观察：贷出者通常对借入者的业务知之甚少。

The asymmetry of information between lender and borrower is a poor substitute for the distinction between, on the one hand, idle money becoming interest-bearing capital alongside accumulation and, on the other, capital functioning in the production of surplus value. In neoclassical theory, the richness of social determinations contained in the distinction between interest-bearing capital and industrial capital, and the primacy of production of surplus value in the course of social reproduction, collapse into the banal observation that the lender usually knows little about the business of the borrower.
马克思成熟著作中对生息资本有两种分析路径。第一种聚焦于拥有货币的“货币资本家”与拥有投资项目的“职能资本家”之间的关系。在这一路径中，生息资本随着货币生产平均利润率的能力在两个资本家之间被交易而形成。利息是“职能”资本家平均产生的利润的一部分。这一路径深受古典政治经济学传统影响，存在若干问题，但主要是因为它不能令人满意地分析产业资本主义积累过程中贷出与借入资本家的各自利益。

There are two approaches to interest-bearing capital in Marx’s mature work. The first concentrates on the relationship between a ‘monied’ capitalist, who possesses money, and a ‘functioning’ capitalist, who possesses an investment project. In this approach, interest-bearing capital is formed as money’s capacity to produce the average rate of profit is traded between the two capitalists. Interest is a share of the profits generated on average by ‘functioning’ capitalists. This approach, which was heavily influenced by the tradition of classical political economy, is problematic for several reasons but primarily because it does not allow for a satisfactory analysis of the separate interests of lending and borrowing capitalists in the course of industrial capitalist accumulation.
第二种路径则聚焦于资本周转中闲置货币的产生，它随后被信用体系转化为借贷资本。货币资本的贷借与利息支付由此被视为闲置货币资金的再配置和剩余价值在若干“职能”资本之间的再分配。这一路径还允许把信用体系作为一套复杂机制加以理论处理：它动员闲置货币并把它转化为借贷资本，在与实际资本积累过程相隔一层的位置上运作。这是分析利息率运动以及马克思如下论断的更坚实基础：平均而言利息率倾向于低于利润率。

The second approach concentrates instead on the generation of idle money in the turnover of the capital, which is subsequently transformed into loanable capital by the credit system. Lending and borrowing of money capital and the payment of interest are thereby treated as the reallocation of spare money funds and the redistribution of surplus value among several ‘functioning’ capitals. This approach also allows for the theoretical treatment of the credit system as a complex set of mechanisms that mobilise idle money and transform it into loanable capital, which operates at one remove from the process of real capital accumulation. This is a more solid basis on which to analyse the motion of the rate of interest as well as Marx’s claim that, on average, the rate of interest tends to be below the rate of profit.
